Create a new beautiful premium cinematic scene in the same strange GAMA laboratory universe, a collision of household grocery life and a dark laboratory museum. A small friendly Grocery Ninja with the SAME simple round silhouette, warm expressive eyes, dark cloth outfit and headband with a subtle single G marking, agile and practical, no weapons, no armor, no robotic machinery, is stepping out of an open glass specimen enclosure carrying a reusable grocery bag full of ordinary groceries. On the workbench are a paper grocery receipt with no readable writing, a few grocery crates, a modest stack of shopping bags, olive jar and familiar produce. Dark graphite metal, brushed stainless fixtures, worn glass, tiny warm amber task lamps, restrained GroceryMaster green containment light, tactile domestic warmth, rich shadow, slightly eccentric storytelling. No people. No fire/explosion/confetti. Background shelves and supermarket logistics extend softly into darkness. Compose the whole main subject and enclosure in central 65% so mobile can show full subject. Give left/top enough darkness for layout breathing room but DO NOT draw website copy. Camera at eye level, realistic premium movie prop photography, detailed but calm, cinematic green-and-warm neutral palette, no blue/purple neon.
ABSOLUTE CONSTRAINTS: no app screens, no smartphones, no tablets, no computer monitors, no interfaces, no diagrams, no graphs, no dashboard, no ratings, no metrics, no numbers, no performance claims, no text except the small G on the cloth headband, no logos or labels elsewhere. Any paper, plaques or tags must be blank. Preserve friendly grocery character continuity from reference. This is physical metaphor, not actual functionality.

Beside it one simple reusable grocery bag, loose receipt paper, a carton of milk, a loaf of bread and an olive jar. Workbench scratches, warm domestic task lamp, background shelves dissolving into shadow, sparse calm composition with tactile real materials and detailed realistic cinematic photography. One object in containment, a small ordinary idea treated very seriously. Large enough central subject to read on a phone, the whole paper and vessel visible, no excessive glow. No character in this early scene. NOT a busy dashboard and NOT a futuristic control room.
Constraints: no smartphones, tablets, screens, product UI, diagrams, futuristic holographic interfaces, readable text, logos, numbers, stats, claims, awards, stars, people, robot, military shapes. All labels/tags blank. Do not invent an app interface. Environment and physical metaphor only.

An extraordinary archive made from ordinary groceries: stainless supermarket shelving and wooden crates meticulously holding bread, milk bottles, fruit, vegetables, olive jars, rice, pasta and modest grocery bags; tactile blank paper catalogue tags and restrained green marker lines connecting shelves like an emerging physical taxonomy.
